routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content + optional color chosen in the composer palette); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
update an existing note's title/content/color; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note (moves it to the Trash); returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
restore a deleted note from the Trash; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing

archive a note from the note actions area, or unarchive it when the note is already archived (body {archived:false} unarchives it, used by the Unarchive action on the archived list and by the Undo action); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
pin or unpin a note (body {pinned:false} unpins it); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
permanently delete a note from the Trash view; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
empty the trash (permanently removes every deleted note); returns 200 with the removed count

notes: REQ-2.6.2 reuses the REQ-2.6.1 color palette (Background options button + Light green swatch) and adds it to the Take a note composer: expanding the composer shows a 'Background options' button (hidden while collapsed, like the Title field and Close button). Picking a swatch stores the pending color in client state and tints the composer; closing the editor POSTs title+content+color so the created note is saved with the selected color. Backend POST /api/notes now accepts an optional color field (validated string or null), reusing the existing color column of the notes data model; GET /api/notes already returns color and the note card already paints note.color as its background. Editing (REQ-2.4) and all other flows are untouched.
